review_scope: Read-only independent review of the strict Ignore helper and watcher; one receipt-after-identity negative test added only to tests.
findings: The old WM_COMMAND wParam 7 was IDNO; IDIGNORE is 5. The replacement selects GetDlgItem(dialog, 5), validates it and posts BM_CLICK directly to that button.
Win32 signatures preserve HWND, WPARAM and LPARAM width and use DWORD for process/thread IDs.

Before and after receipt I/O the helper checks game creation identity, a unique freshly enumerated known assertion for this game PID, matching dialog HWND, dialog/button PID, native dialog class, button parent, control ID 5, visibility, button class and the normalized Ignore label.
The post-receipt check also requires the same button HWND. Unknown, multiple, disappeared or altered assertions fail closed.
The helper calls no foreground, activation, global keyboard or pointer APIs. It does not terminate any process or invoke business bootstrap.
Watcher owner assignment, private runtime project containment, starting/ready states and game/MCDK creation checks remain unchanged. Use exact new water/T02 owners rather than a broader prefix.
Watcher attempts remain bounded to once per session/HWND and at most one known recovery per session. Other or repeated assertions are recorded, not clicked.

The new test changes game identity inside the persisted-target callback, proves the callback was reached exactly once and proves no BM_CLICK was posted. The older identity iterator alone reached failure before receipt I/O.
limits: PostMessage success proves enqueueing, not successful dialog recovery; inspect dismissed and the subsequent session state.
BM_CLICK can fail to complete for native state reasons; this review does not require or authorize activation as a fallback.
Native HWND state can still change after the final validation. The implementation narrows this interval but does not provide atomic validation and delivery.
Earlier common and T02 watcher records had no known_assert_recoveries. They demonstrate configured lifecycle records, not a real successful automated recovery.
Skin-assert recovery does not establish water candidate/bootstrap completion or production acceptance. Timeout must be followed by state inspection without automatic call replay.
